title: Switch Down Payment: Computation Worksheet — Installment Payment Plans
content:
**Quantities.** For a move of a plan of the **Installment Payment Plans** billing an Owner Auto Policy term off automatic draft to the Cardinal Point Six-Pay Direct Bill Plan (amounts in US dollars):

- **Installments already invoiced** are the plan's installment invoices.
- **The plan's own down payment premium** is its recorded down payment amount less the fully earned fees it took: the policy fee booked on the owner term and every filing fee the filing ledger of the Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) shows assessed on the day the plan was set up for the certificate whose backing term is the owner term, whatever that certificate's present status.
- **Its scheduled installment premium** is the full-term premium billed less that down payment premium, divided by the plan's number of installments and rounded half up to the cent.
- **The scheduled premium not yet invoiced** is the full-term premium billed less the plan's own down payment premium and less that scheduled installment premium once for each installment already invoiced.
- **The Cardinal Point Six-Pay Direct Bill Plan's down payment percentage** is 20 percent for the first term of a policy number (the Owner Auto Policy term's term number is 1) and 16 percent for a later term.

**The switch down payment** refigures the down payment as if the term had been enrolled on the Cardinal Point Six-Pay Direct Bill Plan: that percentage of the full-term premium billed, divided by 100, less the plan's own down payment premium, never below zero. A switch down payment is never more than the scheduled premium not yet invoiced, and when it comes to zero none is taken.

**Assembly and rounding.** The down payment percentage, together with any percentages added to it, is applied to the premium basis, less what is taken off it; each part works from the quantities above and none from another's result, and the amount is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end. Apart from the plan's own schedule figures, only the switch down payment itself is rounded.

**When none is due (0.00).** The move is asked on any other plan; or the installment invoice that the payment most recently returned on the plan had paid, or its next installment invoice if already issued, has two or more payments posted against it, a payment not counting when it is the returned payment itself or a makeup referencing it; or the owner term backs two or more certificates.

**Worked figures (hypothetical).** First term; full-term premium billed 1,300.00; recorded down payment amount 246.00 including a policy fee of 25.00 and no certificate. Own down payment premium: 221.00. Scheduled installment premium: 1,300.00 less 221.00 is 1,079.00, divided by 5, 215.80. No installment invoiced yet: scheduled premium not yet invoiced 1,079.00. Switch down payment: 20 percent of 1,300.00, which is 260.00, less 221.00, which is 39.00 — within the 1,079.00 cap. For a later term the percentage would be 16: 208.00 less 221.00 is below zero, so none would be taken.
